notes: Lesson-gate map: what parsing-relevant material each lesson newly introduces, verified against Cook & Holmstedt lesson pages (primary) and appendix cross-references like 'Personal Pronouns (LL5, 11)' (secondary).
Used by tools/validate_bbh_parsing_data.mjs to cross-check every form's introducedLesson, and by the UI for 'what's new at lesson N' and empty-state messages.
Entry shape: {"lesson": N, "introduces": [{"summary": "...", "paradigmIds": ["..."], "source": {"lesson": N, "page": N}}]}. Lessons with no parseable material are simply absent.
Populated in Phase 2 PR B from verified page images. Empty in PR A by design.
